**merge-train (2026-11-21): on this train.** Validated at `2159fd67f`: READY. The test drives the real handler against a real DB, and reverting to truthiness turns it red. The frontend renders 0 as "0%".

The same truthiness bug is still in `perform_health_check` (`services/monitoring_service.py:858-859`), which feeds `POST /api/monitoring/agents/{name}/check` and the GET handler's first-ever-check path. #4685 named only the router, so this PR is correct for its scope. Merged with the findings filed as #4702. You are welcome to take it.

Your CI runs were waiting for maintainer approval; they are approved and running now.
